test_cases_present: partial - the spec defines mandatory protocol behaviors (frame structure, bit/octet stuffing, sequence numbering, FCS, mode-set, error responses) that map directly to compliance test scenarios but does not provide a formal testbench.
derived_compliance_test_categories: FLAG framing — every frame opens and closes with 0x7E; back-to-back frames may share a single flag octet.
Bit stuffing on transmit — inject 0-bit after 5 consecutive 1-bits in Address+Control+Information+FCS region; FLAG itself NEVER stuffed.
Bit de-stuffing on receive — strip 0-bit after 5 consecutive 1-bits; if 7th bit is 1 → abort/error.
Octet stuffing on asynchronous links — 0x7E in payload → 0x7D 0x5E; 0x7D → 0x7D 0x5D; 0x7D 0x7E sequence forces abort.
Abort detection — 7 or more consecutive 1-bits forces frame discard and re-enter FLAG_HUNT.
Minimum frame (Flag + Addr + Ctrl + FCS + Flag = 6 octets) and maximum frame (implementation N1).
I-frame transmission with each N(S) value 0..7 (mod-8) / 0..127 (mod-128).
I-frame piggyback acknowledgement — N(R) acks N(S)<N(R) of peer's I-frames.
S-frame RR — positive ack; resume from prior RNR.
S-frame RNR — throttle peer until next RR.
S-frame REJ — go-back-N retransmission from N(R).
S-frame SREJ — selective retransmission of only N(R) (if supported).
U-frame SABM/SABME/SARM/SARME/SNRM/SNRME — mode-set acceptance (→ UA) and rejection (→ DM or FRMR).
U-frame DISC — link teardown; secondary acknowledges UA then enters DM.
U-frame UA — acceptance of mode-set or DISC.
U-frame DM — disconnected-mode response to any command except acceptable mode-set.
U-frame UI / UIH — unacknowledged datagram-style data.
U-frame XID — capability exchange; ISO 8885 format.
U-frame TEST — loopback / link ping.
U-frame FRMR — frame reject with W/X/Y/Z/V error flags; cleared by mode-set or RSET.
U-frame RSET (ABM) — reset receive sequence number to 0.
U-frame UP — group polling (SDLC).
P/F bit checkpoint — only one token in flight; receiver may assume any unacked frames before its last P/F transmission are lost.
Sequence number wrap modulo 8 / modulo 128.
Sliding window — up to 7 (mod-8) / 127 (mod-128) outstanding I-frames.
FCS error — corrupt frame discarded silently; recovered via REJ/SREJ or T1-driven retransmission.
FCS polynomial conformance — 16-bit CRC-CCITT (0x1021, init 0xFFFF, residue 0x1D0F) and optional 32-bit CRC-32 (0x04C11DB7).
Address extension — top-bit-0 in any address byte means address continues.
Idle-line — continuous 1-bits and continuous 0x7E flags both equivalent.
T1 retransmission timer expiry → retransmit + N2 max-retries → link down.
T2 ack-holdoff timer → triggers piggyback ack via S-frame RR.
Mixed Part-of-the-frame split: extended-control (16-bit) coexistence with normal (8-bit) control on the same link is NOT allowed without re-mode-set.
Mode escalation: SNRM (NRM) → DISC → UA → DM → SABM (ABM) → UA — full mode transition sequence.
